title: GKB7I-53: A novel anti-metastatic agent for colorectal cancer.
authors: Yang, Min Hee; Le, Ducdat; Dang, Thinhulinh; Truong, Vinhquang; Ha, In Jin; Lee, Mina; Ahn, Kwang Seok
one_liner_zh: 该文研究皂苷化合物GKB7I-53抑制结直肠癌转移的EMT通路，仅含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Metastasis driven by epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) remains a critical challenge in colorectal cancer treatment. This study investigated GKB7I-53, a saponin compound isolated through feature-based molecular networking, as a potential therapeutic agent targeting EMT pathways. GKB7I-53 demonstrated minimal cytotoxicity (>90% cell viability at 50 muM) while effectively inhibiting metastatic processes. The compound downregulated mesenchymal markers (CXCR4, CXCR7) and upregulated epithelial markers (E-cadherin, occludin), suppressing EMT progression. In CXCL12-stimulated cells, GKB7I-53 significantly reduced cell migration and invasion while decreasing MMP-2/9 activity, key enzymes facilitating metastatic spread. Mechanistically, GKB7I-53 suppressed MnSOD-induced STAT3 activation, thereby blocking the JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway crucial for metastasis. Molecular docking studies confirmed strong binding affinity to target proteins involved in EMT and cancer progression. These findings suggest that GKB7I-53 may serve as a potential lead compound with anti-metastatic properties in colorectal cancer. Rather than inducing general cytotoxicity, GKB7I-53 selectively modulates EMT-related pathways, indicating a mechanistic basis for its anti-metastatic effects. However, further in vivo validation and preclinical studies are required to determine its therapeutic relevance.
abstract_zh: 由上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT）驱动的转移仍是结直肠癌治疗中的关键挑战。本研究探讨了通过基于特征的分子网络（feature-based molecular networking）分离出的皂苷化合物GKB7I-53，作为靶向EMT通路的潜在治疗剂。GKB7I-53在50 μM浓度下表现出极低的细胞毒性（细胞活力>90%），同时有效抑制转移过程。该化合物下调间质标志物（CXCR4、CXCR7）并上调上皮标志物（E-cadherin、occludin），从而抑制EMT进展。在CXCL12刺激的细胞中，GKB7I-53显著减少细胞迁移和侵袭，同时降低MMP-2/9活性，这些酶是促进转移扩散的关键因子。机制上，GKB7I-53抑制MnSOD诱导的STAT3激活，从而阻断对转移至关重要的JAK/STAT3信号通路。分子对接研究证实其与参与EMT和癌症进展的靶蛋白具有强结合亲和力。这些发现表明，GKB7I-53可能作为具有抗转移特性的潜在先导化合物，用于结直肠癌治疗。GKB7I-53并非通过诱导普遍细胞毒性，而是选择性调节EMT相关通路，这为其抗转移效应提供了机制基础。然而，仍需进一步的体内验证和临床前研究以确定其治疗相关性。
